label: US NEWS
title: Social Security COLA 2027: Benefits Rise 3.6%, the Highest in 4 Years
image_files: File:The New Social Security Administration Office - panoramio.jpg
File:Seminole County Senior Citizens Center, Donalsonville.jpg
paragraphs: Social Security checks are going up next year. Here's exactly how much.
The Social Security Administration just announced a 3.6 percent cost-of-living adjustment for 2027.
That's the highest increase in four years, driven by high inflation. One analysis calls it the fifth-largest in 35 years.
But not everyone gets the full bump. Some federal retirees will see a smaller adjustment.
Will 3.6 percent keep up with your bills? Tell us in the comments.
